utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Dane — I’m happy to help with the carpool. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Mara — sorry I’m late. I just need to know if there’s still a spot for me in the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Dane, yes — there’s still a spot for you in the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what time should I be ready?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll check the pickup time and confirm it before I say anything definite.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Okay, thanks — just let me know when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on the carpool supplies and make sure we’ve got everything ready. Just tell me what you need for the route.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Cleo — I might forget a detail or two, so that’d be a big help. I’ll send over the route stuff when I sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Of course — send it when you’re ready, and I’ll keep it organized. I’ll make sure the carpool supplies are all set.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Pia, I’m happy to help with the carpool. What time are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rey — I’m a little worried about traffic, so maybe we should aim for an earlier pickup time. What works best for you?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Earlier works for me too — I can do a bit before the rush if that helps. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Are we still on for the carpool tomorrow, or do we need to adjust the pickup time?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m not totally sure yet—I heard there might be a small change, but I should check and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks—can you let me know as soon as you check? If it changes, I can adjust my schedule.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the carpool’s still on for this week — same pickup time as before. If anything changes, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — I’ll keep the same pickup time on my end. Thanks for the heads-up, Tess.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You got it, Gus — I’ll shout if I hear any changes.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I can spread the word about the carpool right away. Who should I invite first?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Please start with the folks on Maple Street, especially Ben and Tara—they’re the closest to the pickup spot.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Got it — I’ll start with Maple Street, especially Ben and Tara, and let them know the pickup details right away.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the carpool. What time do you need me?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm what time you’re available?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m available after 3:30 PM, and I can do pickup then.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Bo — I’ve got the carpool list open and I’m ready to sort it out. What time and pickup order works best for you?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Morning pickup works best for me, and I’d go after the first two stops if that’s easy.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Morning works great — I’ll put you after the first two stops. I’ll send the updated pickup order so we’re all set.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll repeat the carpool plan to everyone so we’re all on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’d be helpful, Vik. I like a clear plan—just let me know the pickup time and where to meet.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure — I’ll tell everyone the pickup time and the meeting spot so we’re all set.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the carpool. I’m sorry, I’ve got a lot in my head lately, but I’m happy to help.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. I really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Of course — just tell me what time you need me, and I’ll do my best to keep it straight.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Happy to help — what time do you need the carpool to leave?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Around 7:30 would be great, if that works for you.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep, 7:30 works for me — I’ll make sure we’re ready to roll then.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Dane, I’m putting together the carpool—want in?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, count me in — I usually end up joining late, so just tell me the pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll text you the pickup time as soon as I lock it in.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can help with the carpool. What time are we thinking?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s keep it simple—how about 7:30 in the morning? That gives us a little buffer before school.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: 7:30 works for me. I’ll be ready then.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure — what days and pickup times are we looking at for the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can do Mondays and Wednesdays, with pickup around 7:30 AM. Does that work for you?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, that works for me — I can handle Mondays and Wednesdays at 7:30 AM.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure thing — I can help coordinate the carpool and keep everyone in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Jules — I’ll keep the plan moving and pass updates along to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good, Vik — just send me the latest details and I’ll make sure everyone stays updated.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Pia — I can lend a hand with the carpool. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Gus — I just want to make sure the timing works and everyone knows where to meet.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep — I can help set a time and make sure everyone knows the meetup spot. Just tell me what time you’re thinking.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can track where everyone is headed for the carpool—just tell me the pickup spots and I’ll keep it organized.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’d be wonderful, Opal—thank you. I’ll send you the pickup spots and names right away.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, Rosa—I’ll organize them as soon as you send them over.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Hana, are we still on for the carpool tomorrow?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, I think so—let me double-check the time and I’ll confirm with you.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks—what time works for you?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I’m happy to help with the carpool. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Sam — could you help keep an eye on the schedule and let me know if we’re short on seats or need anyone to bring extra booster seats?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll keep an eye on the schedule and flag it if we’re short on seats or need booster seats.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the carpool’s still on—what time were you thinking, Noah?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, I think we were saying around 8? Sorry, I may have missed if that changed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, 8 sounds right to me too—I'll go with that unless you hear otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, Tess — are we still on for the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, we’re still on for the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, just wanted to make sure.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, right — how’s the carpool looking these days?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It’s still going, mostly steady. I’ve had to lean on it a bit more than usual lately, though.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Got it—glad it’s still holding together. Want me to keep an ear out if anyone’s schedules shift?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the carpool — I might’ve mixed up the days. What time were we saying again?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: We said 7:30 in the morning. If that changed, let me know and I’ll adjust.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah yes, 7:30 — thanks for the reminder. I’ll be ready then and let you know if anything changes.
